note: Private RV park on stocked Heritage Lake at the junction of Highways 2 and 642, just west of Morinville, with transient and seasonal sites, a swimming pool, beach area and pier, pickleball and beach volleyball, canoe and kayak rentals, and RV storage. Also caters to tradespeople working at nearby plants. --Claude
summary: Confirmed C$53 power/water and C$60 full-service daily rates (+GST), weekly/monthly/seasonal rates, May 1 to mid-October season, 54 serviced + 28 seasonal sites, flush toilets, coin showers, wifi, request-form booking, phone 780-939-6040. Wrote fees (low 60->53), season (opens 04-15->05-01, manual), booking, hookups, facilities, sites; note rewritten. Lakefront confirmed for the lake-side rows. Home page says 'CLOSED FOR 2026 camping season!' (end of season, not a status). Amperage unstated; stored 30 A (note-derived) left.

PRESENCE: Google Maps 'Morinville Campground & RV Park' 4.1 from 139 reviews, site morinvillervpark.com. WEBSITE https://www.morinvillervpark.com/ answered 200 (rates-bookings, about, amenities pages and the pamphlet PDF too).
PRICE GATE: C$53 (power and water) / C$60 (full service) plus GST, under C$69. Not near a gateway (not needed).

LONG STAY (five tests): '54 serviced sites, and 28 seasonal sites' (seasonal C$4,500 May-mid-Oct; 'in 2024, they expanded with 29 new seasonal sites'; '*Minimal Seasonal Sites remaining for 2027'); monthly C$950 + power; 'For tradespeople working at nearby plants, we provide easy access'. Daily rates are posted (test 2 passes), no minimum stay, a nightly booking form, and about two thirds of the sites are the serviced transient ones; rules forbid 'sheds, decks, or similar structures'. Not a home community. Passes on what is posted.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - confirmed for the lake-side rows): Heritage Lake is ~400 m across (stocked, with a beach and pier). On Esri imagery the southern RV row sits ~15-35 m above the north shore across the park road and an open grass bank, and the newer pull-in pads to the east (likely the 2024 seasonal expansion) are ~10-40 m from the water over open grass. The northern row next to Highway 642 is ~70-90 m back. Recommend keeping lakefront; which rows are transient is not stated.
PIN (53.80164,-113.66815): at the office/entrance on the lake's northwest corner, beside the site rows; Google's 53.80214,-113.66926 is ~90 m NW. No move.
SITE COUNT: written 54 (the serviced sites the home page counts); the 28 seasonal sites are additional, ~82 in all.
